name: Rugged Adventurer Variant
prompt: Design one variation of first-person fantasy RPG forearms and hands that feels slightly more rugged and adventuring-oriented while staying in the same warm stylized castle-fantasy visual family. Show one paired left/right design only, on a plain background, with clear readable shapes, simple wraps or cuffs, and restrained forged-metal accents. Keep it suitable for later viewmodel development, but this pass is still concept-only. Do not show other alternatives in the same image.
